To enforce this fair 50/50 split of the generated surplus, any return below 20 triggers the maximum punishment level of 10. By returning 20, you secure a payoff of 10 coins. If you return 0 (the best alternative under punishment), your payoff would be reduced to 5 coins (30 - 0 - 25). Therefore, returning 20 is both the most rational and maximally fair choice.
